title: Delivery Window Service Levels by Program (Ridgeline Orders & Delivery)
content:
## Service levels by program

Ridgeline Orders & Delivery books a delivery window of a set number of hours for its timed delivery programs, counts a delivery as late once it arrives more than a set number of minutes after the end of the booked window, and credits a set amount when a delivery arrives late or the truck misses the window. Shipped orders instead have a number of calendar days they may arrive after their promised date before the shipping charge is refunded.

| Fulfillment program | Delivery window booked (hours) | Minutes after the window end after which a delivery is late | Missed-window credit | Missed-window credit combinable with a delivery fee refund on the same order | Days a shipped order may arrive after its promised date before its shipping charge is refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | 0 (no window booked) | 0 | $0.00 | No | 3 |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 0 (no window booked) | 0 | $0.00 | No | 0 (no such refund) |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | 0 (no window booked) | 0 | $0.00 | No | 3 |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | 2 | 30 | $20.00 | No | 0 (no such refund) |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | 4 | 60 | $50.00 | No | 0 (no such refund) |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | 4 | 60 | $50.00 | No | 0 (no such refund) |

A window of 0 hours means no window is booked. A late-shipment figure of 0 means the program grants no such refund.

## Applying the levels (illustrative times and dates)

**Timed windows.** A Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery window booked from 08:00 to 12:00 is four hours long and ends at 12:00. An arrival at 12:45 is 45 minutes after the end, not more than 60, so it does not count as late; an arrival at 13:10 is 70 minutes after the end and counts as late. For a Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery window from 15:00 to 17:00, an arrival at 17:20 is 20 minutes after the end and not late, while one at 17:40 is 40 minutes after and late.

**Shipped orders.** A Ridgeline Ship to Home order promised for 2026-05-04 that arrives on 2026-05-07 has arrived three calendar days after its promised date, within its 3 days; one arriving on 2026-05-08 has arrived four days after, more than 3.

**Combination.** Every program shows "No" in the combination column: on one order the missed-window credit is not combined with a delivery fee refund.
